edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff $34,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after execution of this Agreement.
2. MUTUAL RELEASES. Upon payment of the Settlement Amount, each party releases the other party from all claims arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal and tax advisers, disclosures required for tax or regulatory purposes, or disclosures otherwise required by law. Each party shall inform any adviser receiving confidential information of its confidential nature.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a settlement amount to be agreed in writing by the parties (the “Settlement Amount”). Payment shall be due within ten business days after execution of this Agreement. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
